summary: I tested only the frontend, using Playwright on the web preview at 390x844, 320x700 and 1920x1080, signed in as 7004186276. (A) The series day count now comes from the backend everywhere I checked. On Home: series-home-day shows '50 DAYS', the ring label is '0 of 50 days done' with 'of 50' inside, series-banner-title is '50 daily full mocks', home-tile-live-description is 'opens 9 dec' and home-promo-title contains '50 daily mocks'. On /live, reached both by home-series-view-all and by series-open-hub-button: the eyebrow says '50 DAYS · FULL SYLLABUS', the '50-day map' label is there, the About sheet says '50 days. One focused mission.', streak-done shows '0 /50 days' and 'Starts 9 Dec' is shown. Mission shows '50 daily mocks'. There is no '62' anywhere on Home, /live or Mission. While the count is loading (0), every screen falls back to wording without a number. (B) The Home share card is royal blue (rgb(35,68,204)) and has the title, the 4 perk tiles, 100% FREE, PYQ DNA, 4,000+ PYQs and the 200+ goal. home-share-whatsapp opens api.whatsapp.com/send?text=..., and the message contains JEELIVE.AI, https://jeelive.ai and 200+. home-share-more calls navigator.share with the full text and nothing crashes. The old home-footer is gone, and the home-explore-share chip works without crashing. The buttons measure 256x50 / 52x52 at 390 and 186x50 / 52x52 at 320. At 320px, the perk tile text and the top chip are cut off with '…' (design issue below). (C) The WhatsApp + PDF button pair works on desktop web for rank-pdf, comedk-pdf, bitsat-pdf, tm-pdf (MANIT Bhopal), cmp-pdf and rank-shortlist-pdf. Each WhatsApp tap downloads the right file, opens one api.whatsapp.com popup and shows the 'download hui. WhatsApp khul gaya' message. Each plain PDF tap downloads the file and shows '<file> taiyaar'. The files were JEELIVE-JEE-colleges-180-marks.pdf, JEELIVE-COMEDK-colleges-120-marks.pdf, JEELIVE-BITSAT-280-score.pdf, JEELIVE-target-MANIT-Bhopal.pdf and JEELIVE-saved-colleges-2.pdf, and every saved file starts with %PDF. With the PDF endpoint slowed by 2.5 s, only the tapped button showed a spinner (aria-disabled). A second WhatsApp tap and a PDF tap during that time were both ignored: 1 download and 1 popup. Without the slowdown the server answers in about 200 ms, so a tap 250 ms later is a new, valid export. I also checked the mobile-web share path with a stubbed navigator.share: the file is passed as application/pdf with the caption. NotAllowedError falls back to download plus WhatsApp. AbortError shows the 'taiyaar' message. At 320px the two buttons wrap into two full-width rows, with no horizontal overflow and no cut labels. (D) Regression: Home renders; the 5 rank tools are rank-tool-rank/pct/target/college/compare; the COMEDK result (120 / 180 · GM) stays after switching JEE→COMEDK. There were no page errors in any run. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch). The native Android react-native-share path and the iOS share sheet were not run; web preview can't run them.

issues: The 2-column perk grid cuts off its text with '…': titles 'Rapid Fi…', 'Dream …', 'Mocks …' and lines 'revise in 15-secon…', 'know your rank & …', 'aim with the marks…', 'raise your chances …'. Cause: perk flexBasis 46% plus numberOfLines={1}/{2} on the title and line. Fix: when narrow, show one perk per row (flexBasis 100%), or drop numberOfLines on the title. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/home/ShareCard.tsx:54-58,90

The top chip '100% FREE · FOREVER' is cut to '100% FREE · FO…' at 320px. It has numberOfLines={1} and flexShrink next to the PYQ DNA badge. Fix: shorter text or smaller letterSpacing when narrow. Reference: ShareCard.tsx:38

Two green 'WhatsApp' buttons sit close together: the result-text share next to Shortlist, and the PDF WhatsApp under the filters. Students can't tell which one sends the PDF. Suggest labelling the PDF one 'PDF WhatsApp par' or similar (minor).

action_items: ShareCard: at width < 360, give perk tiles flexBasis 100% (one per row) or remove numberOfLines so 'Rapid Fire', 'Dream college' and 'Mocks + AITS' and their lines are not cut off; also shorten or resize the '100% FREE · FOREVER' chip when narrow.
Optional: relabel the PDF WhatsApp pill (e.g. 'PDF WhatsApp') so it is not confused with the result-share WhatsApp pill above it.

Optional: when the user cancels the web share sheet (AbortError), sendPdfWhatsApp returns via 'sheet' and the UI shows a success line ('taiyaar: list mein WhatsApp chuno aur bhejo'). Consider showing no message instead. Reference: /app/frontend/src/rank/pdf.ts:84
critical_code_review_comments: pdf.ts web path: navigator.share and window.open (via Linking.openURL) run only after an awaited fetch. Real browsers need a recent user tap for both; Chrome allows about 5 s, Safari is stricter. NotAllowedError correctly falls back to download plus WhatsApp. But if the WhatsApp popup is then blocked, Linking.openURL(...).catch swallows it and the UI still says 'WhatsApp khul gaya'. Low risk because the server responds in about 200 ms; worth noting for slow networks.

PdfButton guards against repeat taps with the 'busy' React state, not a ref. Two taps inside the same render frame could both start (stale closure). With realistic tap gaps the guard worked (verified with a slowed network). Using a useRef guard would make it airtight.

success_rate.frontend: about 97%: every requested flow passed; 1 design issue on the 320px share card

seed_data_creation: None. The Shortlist/Compare saves (2 seats) were made only in throwaway Playwright browser storage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: type into entry-phone-input, then entry-pin-input, wait 1.5 s, click entry-continue-button. PDF buttons: wait with page.on('download') and page.context.on('page') listeners and click via locator.evaluate('e=>e.click()'). The PDF server answers in about 200 ms, so to test the busy guard, slow '**/api/rank/pdf/**' with page.route. In the Target marks college sheet use a normal click() on tm-college-sheet-<id> (force click did not register); MANIT is id 2. The exam switch testIDs are rank-exam-jee/bitsat/comedk. The shortlist opens with rank-shortlist-open.
